title: Boundary walls finished to an equivalent standard
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: 'To the satisfaction of the decision-maker' needs a planner.
